extracted.intended_audience: Brown University researchers, faculty, and research staff (investigators and scholars)
extracted.subtask_description: Services and institutional standards for supporting faculty and researchers through the full research lifecycle at a university (pre-award, award management, compliance, IP, and technology transfer). Focused on enabling competitive proposals, compliant conduct, and commercialization pathways.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop initial research strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: Partnering with researchers to develop initial research strategies.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division aims to make the research process less complex by partnering with researchers to develop initial research strategies as an early-stage activity in the research cycle.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify funding opportunities
rubrics_metrics.description: Identify funding opportunities for investigators and teams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division connects researchers to critical resources inside and outside of Brown and helps identify appropriate funding sources as part of positioning teams for competitive proposals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support proposal submission
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services include helping investigators submit proposals — reducing complexity and administrative burden around the proposal submission process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Negotiate contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Negotiate contracts on behalf of the university and researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division supports negotiation of terms with sponsors and partners to establish clear contractual arrangements that enable research activities and protect university interests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Establish funding structures
rubrics_metrics.description: Establish funding structures for projects and awards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Help investigators set up appropriate funding structures once awards are made, including fiscal setup and award management to facilitate project execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Guide technology transfer
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division provides guidance on moving innovations toward commercialization, including intellectual property assessment and pathways for technology transfer.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support startup ventures
rubrics_metrics.description: Support startup ventures that originate from university research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services include support for researchers pursuing startup formation and related commercialization activities, linking them to resources and expertise.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduce administrative workload
rubrics_metrics.description: Reduce the administrative workload for Brown researchers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A stated objective is to decrease researchers' administrative burdens by partnering with them across the research lifecycle so they can focus on scholarship and discovery.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect intellectual property
rubrics_metrics.description: Protect researchers' and university intellectual property.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division works to protect IP as part of its role — advising on disclosure, patenting, and other protections to preserve rights and commercialization potential.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division aims to identify and manage conflicts of interest to maintain ethical standards and compliance in research activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ensure integrity of research
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintaining research integrity is an explicit goal; the Division supports policies, procedures, and oversight to uphold integrity across projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maintain compliance with regulations
rubrics_metrics.description: Maintain compliance with state and federal regulations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division supports researchers to comply with applicable state and federal rules and regulatory requirements relevant to research conduct and funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: Increase external funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Increase external funding of research at Brown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A strategic objective is to help faculty secure more external funding through support services, positioning, and connecting researchers with funders and opportunities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Connect researchers to critical resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Connect researchers to critical resources inside and outside of Brown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division acts as an advocate and connector — linking investigators to campus resources, external partners, events, and networks to support research and collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support individuals and teams throughout the research cycle
rubrics_metrics.description: Support individuals and teams throughout every step of their research endeavors.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Services are offered at every stage — from developing strategies and identifying opportunities to award management, technology transfer, and startup support — emphasizing continuous support for both individuals and collaborative teams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communicate policies, procedures, and guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide announcements and guidance so researchers stay informed about policies, procedures, and guidelines for conducting research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Division publishes announcements and resources (news, events, guidance) to keep the research community up to date on evolving policies, procedures, and institutional guidance relevant to conducting research.
